  "point": [4, 10],
  "do": "continue",
  "notes": "Subject: fish facing right, agreed with Maya. Start at tail pinch (4,10). Pad: stroke 1 top edge from pinch to nose, stroke 2 bottom edge from pinch to nose (both drawn). Once strokes are on the pad, trace 1, 2, 3 and set start on the first build. Watch that stroke 1 leaves the start first."
